1887-5147-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-5147-5254.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat.

728-2558-3490-4050.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1643-2073-5315-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Kolodin triggers, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3334-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1116-2921-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1116-2921-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

512-4241-7704.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4241-7704.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

513-527-5434.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-3129-3899-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1170-4211-4808-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-4211-4808-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

5670-6291-7399.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5670-6291-7399.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

147-7339.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Go Ninja Go.
147-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, ensuring to choose its first mode.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Go Ninja Go, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Go Ninja Go, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

4871-5220-5256-5447.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have solved Case of the Locked Hothouse.
4871-5220-5256-5447.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1753-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2374-2921-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

877-1374-1542-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Wizards of Thay and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

1987-4423-4872-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4872-6991.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

1978-5457-5517.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-5457-5517.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat

2173-4905-5220-5933.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Cast Fanatical Firebrand from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4-1090-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0} and tapping Appa and another creature you control.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

191-5436-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-5436-6625.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

650-5147-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
650-5147-6553.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3129-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1563-2457-3129-4068.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2267-4321-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-4321-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1909-4486-5821.notablePrerequisites: Fyndhorn Elder does not have summoning sickness.
1909-4486-5821.description:
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Fyndhorn Elder.
Repeat.

1753-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
1753-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

947-1132-3062-4772.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, causing it to enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to Doubling Season and Pir.
Heaven Sent's first, second and third chapter ability trigger.
Resolve the first and second triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Resolve the third trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

1182-1456-5220.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Stonecoil Serpent on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.
